fit_scope: train only; no validation/test used for threshold selection
method: Exploratory comparison of CLIP margins and border features; five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by product group, seed42. OOF checks are internal and exploratory, not an independent final evaluation.
limitations: Reviewed examples came mainly from CLIP-uncertain adult train photos, in ID order; not a random catalog sample.
White details can pass; dark backgrounds, people or garments near edges can be wrongly excluded.
Min RGB<0.78 is a foreground proxy, not semantic cloth segmentation.
Metrics exclude uncertain labels; manual corrections take priority. No guarantee of removing every zoom.

additional_checks.interpretation: Four flagged pilot images appeared partial on assistant inspection. Not a complete sensitivity/precision assessment; retained photos not exhaustively reviewed.
